device: Apple Silicon Mac, Chrome (desktop A in the device matrix); tier desktop at 60 fps, the operator's sf bake

steps.instruction: Bake the real city (pnpm map:build -- --area sf, then pnpm map:pack), build the QA bundle with the bake merged in (DV_WORLD=sf VITE_DV_QA=1 pnpm build) and serve it locally (pnpm --filter @dv/edge exec wrangler dev --port 8788). Print this list with pnpm perf:checklist -- tools/ci/checklists/M02b1-mac.json --url http://localhost:8788 to get the local URLs.

In Chrome open http://localhost:8788/?perf=1&tier=desktop&scenario=route-ferry-ocean-beach. The camera flies the 120 s route from the Ferry Building over Civic Center and the Sunset to Ocean Beach. When it ends tap Export and save perf.json and notes.json to docs/device-runs/M02b1/mac/.

Add to notes.json: render (what the sf bake looks like and costs at the desktop tier: render objects, triangles, GPU MB at the end of the route; this is a render figure and is not U-W8, which the M02f1 staging checklist records as the boot time against the tier's boot budget) and the meshing time per chunk (U-W10: the p50 and p95 of the world.mesh job in asset.worker, from the Performance panel or __dvBridge.world.chunks().uploads and the HUD).

Run pnpm perf:verify -- docs/device-runs/M02b1/mac/perf.json --tier desktop --checklist tools/ci/checklists/M02b1-mac.json: median and p95 frame time, frames over 50 ms, render and triangle counts and the cold-download figure must pass.
